title: Consistent Scattering Amplitudes, Yang-Mills, the Higgs Mechanism and the EFTs Beyond
summary: I study constraints on fundamental physics emerging from consistency of a unitary, local and perturbative $S$-matrix in $4d$. For massless particles, some new constraints arising from consistent complex factorisation of $2\rightarrow 2$ amplitudes are derived, leading, in particular, to the complete structure of the gluon three-particle amplitudes, including the geometric restrictions on the Lie algebra, parity and time-reversal symmetry, among other details.
